name: Token-dependent ChordRes with RMS-normalized gate velocity
tagline: Per-token Chord coefficients read normalized velocity.
description: Each zero-start gate reads the position and RMS-normalized velocity. The lookahead and tangent update use physical velocity at its original magnitude.
mechanism: Position and weightless RMS-normalized velocity jointly predict the coefficients at each site
Zero-start projections preserve the initial static model
Triton fuses per-token controls into the saved-force Chord path
limitations: Research run with matched random output projections and a high Chord learning rate.

nodes: Chord read, branch and tangent write
